headline: SpaceX IPO: First Indicative Price At $174 Per Share
summary: SpaceX's first indicative share price is $174 per share, a 29% pop over the IPO price of $135, according to data compiled by the Benzinga Pro platform.

headline: SpaceX Starts Trading At $150, Before Rising To $165: 'Liftoff', Says Elon Musk-Led Company
summary: SPCX stock opens at $150/share, up 11% from its $135 IPO price, making it the largest public offering in history.
